desc: A mystical moss rock spirit, round gray-lavender stone body covered in green moss, two stone legs, glowing teal crack eyes. Not an animal. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body with empty margin, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no background.
